strategies.statement: Operate as a customer-centric, inclusive provider, organised around end-to-end customer outcomes and the needs of vulnerable customers rather than internal functions
strategies.driver: As a regional monopoly for households, trust is earned through service and fairness, and customers compare every interaction against best-in-class digital experiences
strategies.target-outcome: Top-quartile C-MeX customer measure; Priority Services Register reaching 9% of households; affordability support offered to every customer in difficulty by end of 2027

strategies.statement: Run on outcome-based, cross-functional product teams with full ownership of their value stream
strategies.driver: Functional silos create handoff friction and dilute accountability for end-to-end performance
strategies.target-outcome: All value-creating work delivered by persistent product teams by 2026; no project-based funding for in-life products

strategies.statement: Decide with data — every material business decision must cite the evidence that supports it
strategies.driver: Decisions made on intuition are slow to challenge and slow to correct
strategies.target-outcome: Self-serve analytics available to every team; decision logs in place for executive-grade decisions

strategies.statement: Invest on a risk-based, outcome-led basis across the regulatory price-review (AMP) cycle so spend follows resilience and performance, not the plan
strategies.driver: Fixed five-year settlements lock investment ahead of evidence and create sunk-cost momentum, while asset health and resilience risks evolve continuously
strategies.target-outcome: Rolling risk-based investment prioritisation refreshed each year within the AMP envelope; every scheme traceable to a performance commitment or resilience outcome

strategies.statement: Build digital-by-default operations — paper, manual handovers, and bespoke spreadsheets are exceptions, not the norm
strategies.driver: Manual operations cap throughput, hide quality issues, and erode margin
strategies.target-outcome: Top 20 business processes fully digital end-to-end by 2026

strategies.statement: Lead on the environment — treat leakage, pollution, storm-overflow spills, and carbon as primary operational measures, not a reporting overlay
strategies.driver: Regulator, investor, and public expectations on river health, bathing water, and net zero are converging on operational standards, not disclosure
strategies.target-outcome: Leakage reduced 50% against the 2017-18 baseline by 2050 (interim AMP targets met); storm-overflow spills cut materially year-on-year; operational net zero by 2030

activity.notes: Reviewed and refined during the 2026-Q1 architecture cycle.
